name: The Kita-Nippon Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Kita-Nippon Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of commercial banking products and services in Japan. It operates through Banking, Leasing, and Credit Card and Credit Guarantee segment. The company offers services, including deposit, lending, securities investment, foreign exchange, domestic exchange, trust and related services. It is also involved in providing credit cards; and credit guarantee, leasing and financing, computer, software development, and software sale services. The Kita-Nippon Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Morioka, Japan.
